scope: Pinned terminfo.dev@4.0.0 extensions.osc3008-context (no termless function; the terminal path writes ESC[1;1H ESC[2K and OSC 3008;type=test BEL, queries the cursor and returns unmeasuredCellResult, inconclusive by construction; the payload is not a UAPI.15 start or end) replayed byte-exactly over the journaled cursor, with the unchanged pinned code re-run from the retained derived bundle, and preserved. Beside it a separately identified effect contract graded by an independent oracle written from UAPI.15 v1.0 over paired complete stored cells, pane metadata (including the untrusted stored context stack and the ended-record ring) and session status: start and end, nesting, the specification example, an update flushing metadata and ending sub-contexts, BEL and ST terminators, id bounds, field validity, escapes, end metadata, a soft reset leaving the stack alone, and negative controls (the pinned payload, foreign spellings, OSC 133/633 not creating a context and a context not moving the title, working directory or shell state). Stack depth, the ended ring, end-ends-sub-contexts, repeated fields and bare backslashes are policy groups that never decide. Stored untrusted metadata in a disposable direct-local App only: no presentation, command-assist or agent use, no hangup, RIS, alternate-screen or real-emitter claim, no remote/mux, other platforms, common-harness or stock-score claim; the ended ring and original null title/working directory are not restored.
